constraints: Extracted texture-index numbers (#292/#835/#3372 etc.) are not canonical spatial coordinates.
A repeated texture reused on different props supplies one unique textual payload.
Decoded ASCII/Morse output does not itself prove a further ARG endpoint.
Existing puzzle utility (orb board, orb melody) is a strong alternate explanation to a CE cipher.
No candidate supplies a native H108/A-I/81+27 address mapping.
